policy: Only sourced Age I values are encoded as historical facts. Unknowns remain HISTORICAL_VALUE_UNKNOWN.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.purpose: Troop training and dismissal. Each Barracks owns its own sequential training queue.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.purpose: Stores resources protected from ordinary plunder, subject to Age I warehouse/privateering rules.

marketplace.name: Marketplace
marketplace.purpose: Player resource order book for Food, Lumber, Stone and Iron.

feasting_hall.name: Feasting Hall
feasting_hall.purpose: Houses recruited heroes and supports hero management.

embassy.name: Embassy
embassy.purpose: Alliance access and allied troop garrison management.

rally_spot.name: Rally Spot
rally_spot.purpose: Army deployment, exercise and medic camp.

beacon_tower.name: Beacon Tower
beacon_tower.purpose: Incoming invasion warning and progressively detailed enemy intelligence.

forge.name: Forge
forge.purpose: Required for Military Science research and Workshop construction.

stable.name: Stable
stable.purpose: Required for Horseback Riding research and Relief Station construction/upgrades.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.purpose: Required for Metal Casting and Walls; supports mechanical/siege dependencies.

relief_station.name: Relief Station
relief_station.purpose: Speeds transport/reinforcement between own and allied cities from the sending city.

farm.name: Farm
farm.purpose: Produces food in an exterior resource field.

sawmill.name: Sawmill
sawmill.purpose: Produces lumber in an exterior resource field.

quarry.name: Quarry
quarry.purpose: Produces stone in an exterior resource field.

ironmine.name: Iron Mine
ironmine.purpose: Produces iron in an exterior resource field.

michelangelos_script.name: Michelangelo's Script
michelangelos_script.purpose: Required for a normal building upgrade to level 10 where documented.

formulas.warehouse_capacity: sum(completed warehouse base capacities) * (1 + 0.10 * Stockpile level)
formulas.warehouse_protection: allocated share of effective warehouse capacity; food/lumber/stone/iron only; gold never protected
formulas.privateering: effective protected amount = allocated protected amount * (1 - 0.03 * attacker Privateering level)

marketplace_rules.delivery_time_formula: Matched purchases arrive after 30 minutes; sales credit gold immediately.

rally_spot_rules.deployment_food: sum troop hourly food * outbound travel hours; exact legacy rounding isolated in service

demolition_rules.labor_time: same base time as constructing the level being removed, modified by current Construction/Mayor Politics

resource_production.population_shortage: assigned resource labor is deducted from idle population; Age I sources document negative available/idle population, so production is not silently scaled by an invented shortage formula
